AND_THE_SECOND_LIMIT_WHICH_IS_INDEPENDEN: V2's own HANDOFF: the prior race cannot validate the CHANGED pipeline, because the pipeline the race scores is not the one V2 changed. Both limits stand together and neither implies the other.
